Combined approval changes only this mock post; later draft retained
Reply has independent full detail and original review context
Profile comparison, separate availability and profile-only approval
Site tools are separate tabs; account form validation and simulated saving
Account failure and unknown result are not displayed as success
Binding locked and nonowner read-only states have no save
Dynamic assignment confirmation in both directions, current entry and persona
Binding failure, unknown result, and late completion after entry change
No candidate and loading failure binding states
Empty and failure queues, stale submission blocks decisions
World administrator cannot enter site management
Interface language is independent of content language
